name: Compute Cluster S36: Period Independence — Cascading Warmup
description: Tests: chained rolling transforms where total warmup exceeds study period. correlation(90) -> zscore(252) needs 342 bars but 1-year study only has ~252.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S36: Period Independence — Cascading Window Warmup
# =============================================================================
# TRAP 3 repro: correlation(90) -> zscore(252) = 342 bar warmup
# On a 1-year study (~252 bars), zscore output should be mostly NaN.

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

ref = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
ref_close = ref.c

ret = returns(close)
ref_ret = returns(ref_close)

# === CHAIN 1: corr(90) -> zscore(252) — total warmup 342 bars ===
corr_90 = rolling_corr(window=90)(ret, ref_ret)
z_corr_252 = zscore(window=252)(corr_90)

# === CHAIN 2: corr(90) -> zscore(90) — total warmup 180 bars (safe for 1yr) ===
z_corr_90 = zscore(window=90)(corr_90)

# === CHAIN 3: raw correlation only — 90 bar warmup ===
# (control — should always work)

# === CHAIN 4: sma(200) -> zscore(252) — total warmup 452 bars ===
ma_200 = sma(close, 200)
z_ma_252 = zscore(window=252)(ma_200)

# === CHAIN 5: sma(200) -> zscore(90) — total warmup 290 bars ===
z_ma_90 = zscore(window=90)(ma_200)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Chain 1: corr(90)->zscore(252) — SHOULD FAIL on 1yr',
    category='Cascading Warmup',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score (252)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=z_corr_252)

xy_lines(
    title='Chain 2: corr(90)->zscore(90) — SHOULD WORK on 1yr',
    category='Cascading Warmup',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score (90)', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=z_corr_90)

xy_lines(
    title='Chain 3: raw corr(90) — CONTROL',
    category='Cascading Warmup',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=corr_90)

xy_lines(
    title='Chain 4: sma(200)->zscore(252) — SHOULD FAIL on 1yr',
    category='Cascading Warmup',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-SMA (252)', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=z_ma_252)

xy_lines(
    title='Chain 5: sma(200)->zscore(90) — safe but marginal on 1yr',
    category='Cascading Warmup',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-SMA (90)', color=Color.Teal)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=z_ma_90)
